gameDescriptionHtml:
Memory Lost is a story-driven fast-paced cyberpunk shooter where you are not just fighting enemies – you become them. Possess enemies, adapt their weapons and skills, and fight ruthless corporations. Uncover secrets, upgrade abilities, and shape your own fate in this world.

A CYBERPUNK NIGHTMARE – In the sprawling, dystopian city of Detraxis, ruthless corporations rule, conducting inhumane experiments on the helpless. You are an AI, created by RedSky Corporation, now fighting to overthrow your own creators. But in this brutal world, survival demands more than just firepower – it requires intelligence, strategy, and the ability to seize control of your enemies.

BODY-SHIFTING COMBAT – Forget traditional combat – your body is your greatest weapon. As a digital entity, you can possess enemies, instantly adapting their skills, weapons, and abilities. Jump from host to host in rapid succession, combining 77 unique weapons and devastating melee attacks to wipe out your foes.

A WORLD OF SECRETS & CHOICES – [i]Memory Lost[/i] offers more than just action – it delivers a deep, choice-driven narrative with three different endings. Your decisions will shape the fate of Detraxis.

Game Features

  • Control and switch between enemies in real time.
  • 60 enemy types & 10 powerful bosses, each with unique abilities.
  • Five upgrade trees to customize your playstyle.
  • Explore a rich cyberpunk world, divided into diverse hubs and levels.
  • Engage with unique NPCs and uncover hidden stories – some tragic, some darkly humorous.
  • Hack, infiltrate, and outsmart your foes to uncover the truth behind RedSky’s experiments.
  • Hand-drawn animated cutscenes bring the world to life.
